headline: Deploy role has unrestricted permissions across all AWS services and resources

findings.evidence_ref: Lines 44-45 of the added policy: Action = "*", Resource = "*"
findings.explanation: The CodeBuild deploy role can perform any action on any AWS resource, including creating/modifying IAM policies, deleting data, and escalating its own permissions. A compromise of the CodeBuild environment grants complete AWS account access. The PR acknowledges this is temporary, but there must be a concrete plan and timeline to scope this down immediately.
